overview: We start with a short questionnaire about how you find, qualify and close customers, what you spend today and which tools you already use. Then we compare real options on the points that matter to you: price per user, contact limits, email tools, reporting and ease of use. You receive a written recommendation with one clear pick, a runner-up and the reasons behind both, so you can choose without paying for features you will never touch.

faq: Do you favor one CRM brand?
No. We are not tied to any CRM vendor, so the pick follows your answers, your budget and your team size. If a simple spreadsheet or a free plan is enough for now, we will say so.
What do you need from me?
About ten minutes to fill in the questionnaire, plus the names of any tools you use today, such as your email, forms and store. Share your budget range too. We handle the research and the comparison.
Will you set up the CRM I choose?
Selection is its own service and ends with the written recommendation. If you want us to build it, CRM Setup is a separate order, and the plan we write can be used as the brief for it.
Can you compare tools I already found?
Yes. Send the names or links of any CRMs you are considering and we include them in the comparison first, then add alternatives we think fit better. We note where we could not verify a detail.
